analysis_role: Post-result spatial-scale decomposition of the already-fixed orientation transition-regime hypothesis. Reuse the exact (+BIO15,-BIO1) CTMC/Brownian estimator and frozen occurrence assets to ask whether the observed concordance is primarily among Japan/Taiwan regional contexts, within regions, or remains exceptional after preserving region-specific orientation-state frequencies.

fixed_hypothesis.estimator: Identical symmetric-CTMC edge-joint posterior x Brownian branch-shift composite used by chapter2_orientation_transition_regime_hypothesis_v1.

decomposition.scale: Use the n>=5 12-taxon panel because it is the smallest frozen occurrence gate with four Taiwan taxa and eight Japan taxa, allowing an explicit two-region decomposition without adding taxa or occurrence sources.
decomposition.standardization: First z-score each taxon centroid across the full 12-taxon panel exactly as in H1. Then decompose each standardized axis additively into region mean plus taxon deviation from region mean: z_total = z_between_region + z_within_region. Do not z-score the two components again.
decomposition.between_region_component: For each taxon and axis, assign the mean standardized value of its declared region (Japan or Taiwan).
decomposition.within_region_component: For each taxon and axis, subtract its declared region mean from its full-panel standardized value.
decomposition.additivity_check: Require z_total = z_between_region + z_within_region to machine precision for both BIO15 and BIO1.

tests.T0_total_reproduction: Reproduce the frozen n>=5 H1 total-environment result before interpreting scale decomposition.
tests.T1_between_region: Apply the unchanged transition-regime statistic to the between-region environmental component and rank the observed map among all 792 count-preserving maps.
tests.T2_within_region: Apply the unchanged transition-regime statistic to the within-region environmental component and rank the observed map among all 792 count-preserving maps.
tests.T3_region_frequency_preserving_null: Preserve the observed number of downward states separately in Japan (3/8) and Taiwan (2/4), enumerate all 336 such maps, and rank the observed total, between-region and within-region composite statistics within that constrained universe.
tests.T4_leave_one_region_out: Re-run the unchanged panel estimator within Japan alone (8 taxa; 56 maps) and Taiwan alone (4 taxa; 6 maps). Taiwan-only exact ranks are coarse diagnostic bounds because only six maps exist.

decision_interpretation.between_region_dominant: Between-region component is exceptional under the all-map null while within-region is not, and the full observed total is no longer exceptional under the region-frequency-preserving null.
decision_interpretation.regional_composition_not_sufficient: The full observed total remains exceptional under the region-frequency-preserving null, indicating that region-specific U/D counts alone do not account for the observed concordance.
decision_interpretation.within_region_signal_retained: The within-region component is positive on all six topologies and exceptional under its declared finite-map null.
decision_interpretation.mixed_scale: Both between-region and within-region components retain directional/exceptional structure, or constrained-null results do not support a single dominant scale.

claim_ceiling: This is a post-result scale decomposition, not an independent preregistered replication.
Japan and Taiwan are the only region classes in the frozen occurrence assets used here; do not generalize the result to all East Asia without new data.
Region-preserving map fractions are finite conditional ranks, not biological-replicate P values.
A between-region result does not establish a regional climatic cause; it identifies the spatial scale at which present-niche transition concordance is organized.
Do not alter the fixed BIO15/BIO1 vector, taxon panel, region assignment, or add predictors after result inspection.
Do not infer selection, adaptation, historical transition-time climate, or a physiological mediator.
